     8	/-!
     9	# The widened vehicle and divisor functor: carrying a widened class to a GENERAL test
    10	
    11	`divFamZarAff_of_forall_prime_certified_adaptation` (`…AffAssemble.lean`) is the endpoint of
    12	the widened certificate lane, and what it returns is a class **at an affine test**
    13	`DivFamZarAff C R n`.  Every DD-R consumer is stated against a *functor* on the whole slice
    14	over `Spec k`, so between the lane's endpoint and its consumers sits the affine-opens limit —
    15	the `divFamZar` vehicle of `DivisorFamilyZarVehicle.lean` — and that layer had no widened
    16	counterpart.  This file supplies it, following the chart-typed template line for line.
    17	
    18	## The shape, and why it is unchanged by R2
    19	
    20	A section over a test `T` is a family of widened classes, one per affine open of `T.left`,
    21	compatible under restriction.  R2 widened where the pieces live **on the curve**; it changed
    22	nothing about the Zariski structure of the **base**.  So the vehicle's shape is literally the
    23	old one with `DivFamZar` replaced by `DivFamZarAff` and `mapAlgHom` by the widened face of
    24	`…AffFace.lean` — which is precisely why that face had to exist first.
    25	
    26	`[IsProper C.hom]` is carried throughout: the widened base change needs it (an arbitrary affine
    27	open's overlaps are not affine by fiat), and it is a hypothesis the DD-R lane has everywhere.
    28	
    29	## What this file does NOT do, stated precisely
    30	
    31	It defines the widened vehicle and proves its affine collapse.  It does **not** define the
    32	restriction `divFamZarAff.map` along an arbitrary morphism of test objects, and therefore does
    33	not define the widened *functor* either.  That is the remaining item of the R2 lane
    34	(`informal/spec-dd-r.md` ADDENDUM 8 §8.3 item 2): its input is the widened form of the base-side
    35	Zariski gluing keystone `DivFamZar.exists_glue_of_away_compat`
    36	(`Picard/DivisorFamilyZarGlue.lean`), which should port because R2 left the base side alone —
    37	but "should port" is a price, not a result, and nothing here assumes it.
    38	
    39	So a consumer can today be given a widened section over an **affine** test, and the general-test
    40	statement is still owed.  Saying which is which is the point of this paragraph: a docstring that
    41	advertises declarations a file does not contain is its own failure mode, and this tree has
    42	already been bitten by it once.
    43	
    44	The comparison from the chart-typed side, `divFamZarToAffVehicle` below, does exist, and it goes
    45	old → new only — the direction R2 asserts.  The converse is exactly what R2 says fails.
    46	
    47	## Main declarations
    48	
    49	* `AlgebraicGeometry.divFamZarAff` — the widened affine-opens limit at an arbitrary test.
    50	* `divFamZarAff.eval`, `divFamZarAff.compat`, `divFamZarAff.ext` — the section API.
    51	* `AlgebraicGeometry.divFamZarAffAffineEquiv` — on an affine test the limit collapses to
    52	  `DivFamZarAff` of the test algebra.
    53	* `AlgebraicGeometry.divFamZarToAffVehicle` — the comparison of vehicles, with
    54	  `divFamZarAffAffineEquiv_toAffVehicle` for its coherence with the two affine collapses.
    55	-/

   320	/-- The widened affine comparison intertwines the section-ring pullback along `Spec` of an
   321	algebra map with the algebra map itself (local copy of the `PicEtMap` helper). -/
   322	private lemma overSpecΓTop_appLE_comp_aff (φ : A →ₐ[k] B) :
   323	    (Over.overSpecΓTopAlgEquiv k B).toAlgHom.comp
   324	      (Over.appLEAlgHom (Over.overSpecMap φ) (overSpecTopAffine A).1
   325	        (overSpecTopAffine B).1 le_top)
   326	      = φ.comp (Over.overSpecΓTopAlgEquiv k A).toAlgHom := by
   327	  have key : (Over.overSpecMap φ).left.appLE (overSpecTopAffine A).1
   328	        (overSpecTopAffine B).1 le_top ≫ (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of B)).hom
   329	      = (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of A)).hom ≫ CommRingCat.ofHom φ.toRingHom := by
   330	    have h₁ : (Over.overSpecMap φ).left.appLE (overSpecTopAffine A).1
   331	          (overSpecTopAffine B).1 le_top
   332	        = (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ.toRingHom)).appTop :=
   333	      Scheme.Hom.appLE_eq_app _
   334	    rw [h₁]
   335	    exact Scheme.ΓSpecIso_naturality (CommRingCat.ofHom φ.toRingHom)
   336	  ext x
   337	  exact congr($(key).hom x)
   338	
   339	/-- **Naturality of the widened affine comparison**: over affine tests, `divFamZarAff.map` along
   340	`Spec` of an algebra map corresponds to `DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom` of that map under the widened
   341	collapse `divFamZarAffAffineEquiv`.
   342	
   343	This is the coherence that carries the widened certificate lane's endpoint (which lands at an
   344	affine test) into the functor: the glued general-test restriction agrees with the widened total
   345	base change wherever both are defined. -/
   346	theorem divFamZarAffAffineEquiv_naturality (φ : A →ₐ[k] B)
   347	    (s : divFamZarAff C n (overSpec k A)) :
   348	    divFamZarAffAffineEquiv C n B (divFamZarAff.map C n (Over.overSpecMap φ) s)
   349	      = DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom φ (divFamZarAffAffineEquiv C n A s) := by
   350	  rw [divFamZarAffAffineEquiv_apply, divFamZarAffAffineEquiv_apply, divFamZarAff.map_val]
   351	  have hval := divFamZarAff.mapVal_eq_mapAlgHom C n (Over.overSpecMap φ) s
   352	    (W := overSpecTopAffine B) (V := overSpecTopAffine A) le_top
   353	  rw [hval]
   354	  calc DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom (Over.overSpecΓTopAlgEquiv k B).toAlgHom
   355	        (DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom (Over.appLEAlgHom (Over.overSpecMap φ)
   356	          (overSpecTopAffine A).1 (overSpecTopAffine B).1 le_top)
   357	          (s.1 (overSpecTopAffine A)))
   358	      = DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom ((Over.overSpecΓTopAlgEquiv k B).toAlgHom.comp
   359	          (Over.appLEAlgHom (Over.overSpecMap φ)
   360	            (overSpecTopAffine A).1 (overSpecTopAffine B).1 le_top))
   361	          (s.1 (overSpecTopAffine A)) := (DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom_comp _ _ _).symm
   362	    _ = DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom (φ.comp (Over.overSpecΓTopAlgEquiv k A).toAlgHom)
   363	          (s.1 (overSpecTopAffine A)) := by
   364	        rw [overSpecΓTop_appLE_comp_aff φ]
   365	    _ = DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom φ (DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom
   366	          (Over.overSpecΓTopAlgEquiv k A).toAlgHom (s.1 (overSpecTopAffine A))) :=
   367	        DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom_comp _ _ _
   368

     8	/-!
     9	# The widened vehicle and divisor functor: carrying a widened class to a GENERAL test
    10	
    11	`divFamZarAff_of_forall_prime_certified_adaptation` (`…AffAssemble.lean`) is the endpoint of
    12	the widened certificate lane, and what it returns is a class **at an affine test**
    13	`DivFamZarAff C R n`.  Every DD-R consumer is stated against a *functor* on the whole slice
    14	over `Spec k`, so between the lane's endpoint and its consumers sits the affine-opens limit —
    15	the `divFamZar` vehicle of `DivisorFamilyZarVehicle.lean` — and that layer had no widened
    16	counterpart.  This file supplies it, following the chart-typed template line for line.
    17	
    18	## The shape, and why it is unchanged by R2
    19	
    20	A section over a test `T` is a family of widened classes, one per affine open of `T.left`,
    21	compatible under restriction.  R2 widened where the pieces live **on the curve**; it changed
    22	nothing about the Zariski structure of the **base**.  So the vehicle's shape is literally the
    23	old one with `DivFamZar` replaced by `DivFamZarAff` and `mapAlgHom` by the widened face of
    24	`…AffFace.lean` — which is precisely why that face had to exist first.
    25	
    26	`[IsProper C.hom]` is carried throughout: the widened base change needs it (an arbitrary affine
    27	open's overlaps are not affine by fiat), and it is a hypothesis the DD-R lane has everywhere.
    28	
    29	## What this file does NOT do, stated precisely
    30	
    31	It defines the widened vehicle and proves its affine collapse.  It does **not** define the
    32	restriction `divFamZarAff.map` along an arbitrary morphism of test objects, and therefore does
    33	not define the widened *functor* either.  That is the remaining item of the R2 lane
    34	(`informal/spec-dd-r.md` ADDENDUM 8 §8.3 item 2): its input is the widened form of the base-side
    35	Zariski gluing keystone `DivFamZar.exists_glue_of_away_compat`
    36	(`Picard/DivisorFamilyZarGlue.lean`), which should port because R2 left the base side alone —
    37	but "should port" is a price, not a result, and nothing here assumes it.
    38	
    39	So a consumer can today be given a widened section over an **affine** test, and the general-test
    40	statement is still owed.  Saying which is which is the point of this paragraph: a docstring that
    41	advertises declarations a file does not contain is its own failure mode, and this tree has
    42	already been bitten by it once.
    43	
    44	The comparison from the chart-typed side, `divFamZarToAffVehicle` below, does exist, and it goes
    45	old → new only — the direction R2 asserts.  The converse is exactly what R2 says fails.
    46	
    47	## Main declarations
    48	
    49	* `AlgebraicGeometry.divFamZarAff` — the widened affine-opens limit at an arbitrary test.
    50	* `divFamZarAff.eval`, `divFamZarAff.compat`, `divFamZarAff.ext` — the section API.
    51	* `AlgebraicGeometry.divFamZarAffAffineEquiv` — on an affine test the limit collapses to
    52	  `DivFamZarAff` of the test algebra.
    53	* `AlgebraicGeometry.divFamZarToAffVehicle` — the comparison of vehicles, with
    54	  `divFamZarAffAffineEquiv_toAffVehicle` for its coherence with the two affine collapses.
    55	-/

    58	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false

    76	
    77	variable (C n)
    78	
    79	/-- **The widened locally certified divisor functor at an arbitrary test object.**  Compatible
    80	families of *widened* locally certified divisor classes over the affine opens of `T.left`: the
    81	value at a smaller affine open is the base change of the value at a larger one along the
    82	section-restriction algebra map.
    83	
    84	Identical in shape to `divFamZar` (`DivisorFamilyZarVehicle.lean`), with `DivFamZarAff` in
    85	place of `DivFamZar` — R2 widens the curve side and leaves the base side alone.  The
    86	compatibility is spelled with `DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom`, which is why the explicit-map face had
    87	to be built first: `Over.resAlgHom` carries no algebra-tower instance. -/
    88	def divFamZarAff (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) : Type u :=
    89	  {s : Π U : T.left.affineOpens, DivFamZarAff C Γ(T.left, U.1) n //
    90	    ∀ (U V : T.left.affineOpens) (h : U.1 ≤ V.1),
    91	      DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom (Over.resAlgHom T h) (s V) = s U}

    95	variable {C n} {T : Over (Spec (.of k))}

    97	/-- The compatibility of a section of `divFamZarAff` along an inclusion of affine opens. -/
    98	lemma compat (s : divFamZarAff C n T) (U V : T.left.affineOpens) (h : U.1 ≤ V.1) :
    99	    DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom (Over.resAlgHom T h) (s.1 V) = s.1 U :=
   100	  s.2 U V h
   101	
   102	/-- Two sections of `divFamZarAff` agreeing at every affine open are equal. -/
   103	@[ext]
   104	lemma ext {s t : divFamZarAff C n T} (h : ∀ U : T.left.affineOpens, s.1 U = t.1 U) :
   105	    s = t :=
   106	  Subtype.ext (funext h)
   107	
   108	variable (C n T) in
   109	/-- Evaluation of a section of `divFamZarAff` at an affine open. -/
   110	def eval (U : T.left.affineOpens) : divFamZarAff C n T → DivFamZarAff C Γ(T.left, U.1) n :=
   111	  fun s => s.1 U
   112	
   113	/-- Evaluation is projection to the component at the affine open. -/
   114	@[simp]
   115	lemma eval_apply (U : T.left.affineOpens) (s : divFamZarAff C n T) :
   116	    eval C n T U s = s.1 U :=
   117	  rfl

   123	section Affine

   125	variable (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [Algebra k R]
   126	
   127	/-- Evaluation at the top affine open of an affine test, composed with the `ΓSpecIso`-transport
   128	into the test algebra: the forward direction of the widened affine comparison. -/
   129	def divFamZarAffToAff : divFamZarAff C n (overSpec k R) → DivFamZarAff C R n :=
   130	  fun s => DivFamZarAff.congr (Over.overSpecΓTopAlgEquiv k R) (s.1 (overSpecTopAffine R))
   131	
   132	/-- The section of `divFamZarAff` over an affine test determined by a widened locally certified
   133	class of the test algebra: restrict from the top affine open. -/
   134	def divFamZarAffOfAff : DivFamZarAff C R n → divFamZarAff C n (overSpec k R) :=
   135	  fun x =>
   136	    ⟨fun U => DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom
   137	      ((Over.resAlgHom (overSpec k R) le_top).comp
   138	        (Over.overSpecΓTopAlgEquiv k R).symm.toAlgHom) x,
   139	      fun U V h => by rw [← DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom_comp, ← AlgHom.comp_assoc,
   140	        Over.resAlgHom_comp]⟩
   141	
   142	/-- The value of `divFamZarAffOfAff` at every affine open is the restricted transported
   143	class. -/
   144	lemma divFamZarAffOfAff_val (x : DivFamZarAff C R n)
   145	    (U : (overSpec k R).left.affineOpens) :
   146	    (divFamZarAffOfAff C n R x).1 U
   147	      = DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom
   148	          ((Over.resAlgHom (overSpec k R) le_top).comp
   149	            (Over.overSpecΓTopAlgEquiv k R).symm.toAlgHom) x :=
   150	  rfl
   151	
   152	/-- Round trip on the vehicle side: restricting the transported top value recovers every
   153	component, by the compatibility of the section. -/
   154	private lemma divFamZarAffOfAff_divFamZarAffToAff (s : divFamZarAff C n (overSpec k R)) :
   155	    divFamZarAffOfAff C n R (divFamZarAffToAff C n R s) = s := by
   156	  refine divFamZarAff.ext fun U => ?_
   157	  calc (divFamZarAffOfAff C n R (divFamZarAffToAff C n R s)).1 U
   158	      = DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom
   159	          (((Over.resAlgHom (overSpec k R) le_top).comp
   160	              (Over.overSpecΓTopAlgEquiv k R).symm.toAlgHom).comp
   161	            (Over.overSpecΓTopAlgEquiv k R).toAlgHom)
   162	          (s.1 (overSpecTopAffine R)) :=
   163	        (DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom_comp _ _ _).symm
   164	    _ = DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom (Over.resAlgHom (overSpec k R) le_top)
   165	          (s.1 (overSpecTopAffine R)) := by
   166	        rw [AlgHom.comp_assoc,
   167	          show (Over.overSpecΓTopAlgEquiv k R).symm.toAlgHom.comp
   168	              (Over.overSpecΓTopAlgEquiv k R).toAlgHom
   169	            = AlgHom.id k Γ((overSpec k R).left, ⊤) from
   170	            AlgHom.ext fun a => (Over.overSpecΓTopAlgEquiv k R).symm_apply_apply a,
   171	          AlgHom.comp_id]
   172	    _ = s.1 U := s.compat U (overSpecTopAffine R) le_top
   173	
   174	/-- Round trip on the algebra side: the two `ΓSpecIso` transports and the trivial restriction
   175	collapse to the identity (`DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom_id`). -/
   176	private lemma divFamZarAffToAff_divFamZarAffOfAff (x : DivFamZarAff C R n) :
   177	    divFamZarAffToAff C n R (divFamZarAffOfAff C n R x) = x := by
   178	  calc divFamZarAffToAff C n R (divFamZarAffOfAff C n R x)
   179	      = DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom
   180	          ((Over.overSpecΓTopAlgEquiv k R).toAlgHom.comp
   181	            ((Over.resAlgHom (overSpec k R) le_top).comp
   182	              (Over.overSpecΓTopAlgEquiv k R).symm.toAlgHom)) x :=
   183	        (DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom_comp _ _ _).symm
   184	    _ = DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom (AlgHom.id k R) x := by
   185	        rw [show Over.resAlgHom (overSpec k R) (le_top :
   186	              (⊤ : (overSpec k R).left.Opens) ≤ (⊤ : (overSpec k R).left.Opens))
   187	            = AlgHom.id k Γ((overSpec k R).left, ⊤) from Over.resAlgHom_rfl _ le_top,
   188	          AlgHom.id_comp,
   189	          show (Over.overSpecΓTopAlgEquiv k R).toAlgHom.comp
   190	              (Over.overSpecΓTopAlgEquiv k R).symm.toAlgHom
   191	            = AlgHom.id k R from
   192	            AlgHom.ext fun a => (Over.overSpecΓTopAlgEquiv k R).apply_symm_apply a]
   193	    _ = x := DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom_id x
   194	
   195	/-- **The widened affine comparison equivalence**: on an affine test `overSpec k R`, the
   196	widened affine-opens limit collapses by evaluation at the terminal element `⊤` of the
   197	affine-opens poset to the widened value `DivFamZarAff C R n` of the test algebra.
   198	
   199	This is what makes the vehicle a genuine extension rather than a new object: the widened
   200	certificate lane's endpoint lands in the right-hand side, so this equivalence is the step that
   201	carries it into the vehicle.
   202	
   203	**Exactly how far that reaches, stated so nobody over-reads it.**  It carries the endpoint into
   204	a vehicle *section over an affine test*, and no further.  Getting from there to a general test
   205	is `divFamZarAff.map` along an arbitrary morphism of test objects, which does **not** exist yet

   207	Zariski gluing keystone `DivFamZar.exists_glue_of_away_compat`.  So the honest reading of this
   208	file is: the widened value now has a vehicle and collapses correctly on affine tests; the
   209	Zariski-continuous *extension* to all tests is still owed. -/
   210	def divFamZarAffAffineEquiv :
   211	    divFamZarAff C n (overSpec k R) ≃ DivFamZarAff C R n where
   212	  toFun := divFamZarAffToAff C n R
   213	  invFun := divFamZarAffOfAff C n R
   214	  left_inv := divFamZarAffOfAff_divFamZarAffToAff C n R
   215	  right_inv := divFamZarAffToAff_divFamZarAffOfAff C n R
   216	
   217	/-- The widened affine comparison evaluates at the top affine open and transports along
   218	`Over.overSpecΓTopAlgEquiv`. -/
   219	@[simp]
   220	lemma divFamZarAffAffineEquiv_apply (s : divFamZarAff C n (overSpec k R)) :
   221	    divFamZarAffAffineEquiv C n R s
   222	      = DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom (Over.overSpecΓTopAlgEquiv k R).toAlgHom
   223	          (s.1 (overSpecTopAffine R)) :=
   224	  rfl
   225	
   226	/-- The inverse widened affine comparison restricts the transported class from the top affine
   227	open. -/
   228	@[simp]
   229	lemma divFamZarAffAffineEquiv_symm_apply_val (x : DivFamZarAff C R n)
   230	    (U : (overSpec k R).left.affineOpens) :
   231	    ((divFamZarAffAffineEquiv C n R).symm x).1 U
   232	      = DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom
   233	          ((Over.resAlgHom (overSpec k R) le_top).comp
   234	            (Over.overSpecΓTopAlgEquiv k R).symm.toAlgHom) x :=
   235	  rfl

    10	# Category-correct ambient contract for the rank-one Picard route
    11	
    12	The rank-one locus lives in degree `genus C`, not in `pic0`. This module installs the concrete
    13	ambient maps that the later open-locus restriction must consume:
    14	
    15	* `abelDivAffTrans` maps the widened degree-`n` divisor functor to `picDegLayerFunctor C n`;
    16	* `abelDivAffSigma` extends a represented slice map to the ambient big-site presheaf;
    17	* `abelDivAffGenusSigma` specializes the map using the canonical genus representation.
    18	
    19	The future public `PicRankOneOpen` must therefore be a subfunctor of
    20	`picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C)`, and `DivRankOneOpen` must be an open of
    21	`divRepAffGenusScheme C`. Its `rankOneAbel` is the restriction of
    22	`abelDivAffGenusSigma`, after applying the corresponding Sigma extension. No placeholder locus,
    23	inverse, representability witness, or endgame theorem is postulated here.

    45	  naturality T T' g := by
    46	    ext s
    47	    refine Subtype.ext ?_
    48	    exact (picEtMap_abelDivAff' g.unop s).symm
    49	
    50	@[simp]
    51	lemma abelDivAffTrans_app_coe
    52	    (T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ) (s : divFamZarAff C n T.unop) :
    53	    ((abelDivAffTrans C n).app T s).1 = abelDivAff' C n T.unop s :=

    62	  rep.toSigmaExtension ≫ Over.sigmaExtensionNat (abelDivAffTrans C n)

    67	    (x : T.unop ⟶ D.left) :

    74	    (x : T.unop ⟶ D.left) :
    75	    ((abelDivAffSigma C n rep).app T x).2.1 =

    82	This is the map that the future rank-one divisor open must restrict. It is not itself claimed to
